notes: litert-community/WeVisOne-VL-4B: WeVisOne-VL-4B_int8.litertlm, the repo's file for a CPU (its GPU file is WeVisOne-VL-4B_int4.litertlm), a LiteRT-LM fast_vlm conversion of tencent/WeVisOne-VL-4B (apache-2.0; WeChat Vision, Tencent; built on Qwen3-VL; converted from the float32 release at revision 4a7bed92, whose weights the current bfloat16 release 6b44a458 holds) — detection, referring, pointing, counting and OCR answers as <0>…<1000> coordinate tokens; to the segmentation and matting templates the file answers with a box and no mask (the pixel decoder is not in the file). Pictures are stretched to 512 x 512 before they are sent. Text-only conversations past 271 tokens shift the text positions (the first 271 tokens are exact). LiteRT-LM 0.18.1 and 0.19.1 feed the previous answer's stop token with a zero embedding from a conversation's second message on (files with an EMBEDDER section), so every row here is a one-question conversation except the suite's two_turn text row. Its first CPU process writes about 5.69 GB of XNNPACK cache files next to the model. Galaxy S26 rows: run r9 hold g9d (2026-11-10 23:38 – 11-11 00:03 JST on its own phone RFGL80R6A6H), the stock v0.19.1 tag build (build A), whose log reads 'Statically linked GPU accelerator registered.'; the CPU backend (XNNPACK) with 4 threads and the vision encoder on the CPU. Landed 2026-11-11: the file is on the Hub at litert-community/WeVisOne-VL-4B (commit f8ca054cc9ae481fe120d922383e2829c19a16af, 2026-11-10 17:04:03 UTC = 2026-11-11 02:04:03 JST, the file with its card rows, MEASUREMENTS.md and its manifest entry in one commit; main f8ca054cc9ae481fe120d922383e2829c19a16af at the read); its LFS oid equals artifact_sha256 and its size 5358955008 B (anonymous API read 2026-11-11 02:21:47 JST).
quantization: int8 weights with one scale per output channel (ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.0, dynamic_wi8_afp32) in the decoder, its output layer included, and in the token embedder; float16 vision encoder and adapter; no activation type declared; no GPU composites (the file for a CPU); fast_vlm at 512 x 512 (256 image tokens), 10,244-wide image rows (Qwen3-VL DeepStack), KV cache 2048
